{{Quote|Hey. We heard the supply run to Teralov failed.|[[Ezra Bridger]]|<ref name="TAE">{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}}</ref>}}
'''Teralov''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref> where the rebellion attempted to take supplies<ref name="TAE" /> in [[2 BBY]].<ref name="HC-57">{{HelmetCollectionCite|57|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> However en route, the rebel [[Starship|ships]] were [[Massacre near Teralov|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military|forces]] led by [[Captain]] [[Vult Skerris]], a brief battle occurred resulting in the destruction of all the rebel ships and failure to deliver the supplies.<ref name="TAE" />
